name: Campground
description: Camp Zombdash at dusk, the evening it was evacuated: the kids got out on the bus, the counselors stayed behind. The mess hall where they made their last stand, the cabins left mid-packing, the waterfront with its boathouse, swim dock and raft, the amphitheater set for talent night, a creek with a footbridge, the tent sites, the lot where the bus waited.
